title: I thought I could learn it
story: So, there is a project that I have been a part of for  a while. Apparently it is completely different from major but because life gave me an opportuniyt so, I did not want to be miss. At start, I was so confident that yeah, I could learn this thing. For the record, it a platform where you build games and stuff and I have never been a gaming person so, i did not even tho this. Back to the main thing, I was so confident that I could learn this. I even made one level of game, on the top of that TWICEEEEE, and I still could not meet the expectations. So, now they said 'okay we should let someone else handle this because we are short of TIME. And its true, we are literally short of time and also because every one else on the team already has been working with that software. So, it stings quite a bit. That I could not be useful enough even tho I did want to. The hopeful part is, I am working with other stuff now, which I have also never done before. But to me, its new and its exciting ang I am going to take this as my learning. ( Not that I considered the 1st gaming platform as waste of time :)
